outfit.name: 尚蒂伊深黑蕾丝深V长裙与哥特腿环
outfit.prose: A breathtaking black Chantilly lace lingerie gown with a plunging scalloped neckline, sheer underbust corsetry, and a hip-high side slit. A double-tiered black leather thigh ring with miniature silver studs tightly hugs her curvy upper thigh, accompanied by an open velvet draped night robe.
